calculator.invalidInput: Check the values above — something isn't a valid number yet.
calculator.explainerPowder: Enter the vial size and how much diluent you added, then the dose you want to log — the draw volume updates as you type.
calculator.explainerSolution: This compound is a ready-to-use solution, so there's no reconstitution step — just enter its concentration directly.
calculator.lowVolumeWarning: This draw is small enough that it may be hard to measure precisely on this syringe.
calculator.bacWaterHelp: BAC water is bacteriostatic water: sterile water with a preservative. It is what the powder gets mixed into.
calculator.saveBody: Attach this mix to one of your active protocols so you can see how much to draw.
calculator.noActiveProtocol: You don't have an active protocol for {{compound}} yet.

protocols.customDaysHint: Tap any days on the calendar. They don't have to follow a pattern.

protocols.savedBody: Next step: mix your vial. The calculator works out how much water to add and where to draw for {{dose}}.

notifications.description: Pending items that need your attention.
notifications.enableNudgeBody: Get an alert when your next dose is due.
notifications.emptyBody: Nothing needs your attention right now.

notif.needsInstallIOS: On iPhone/iPad, notifications only work after adding USA Peptide Depot to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4+). See Install below.
notif.denied: Notifications are blocked. Enable them for USA Peptide Depot in your device settings to turn them back on.
notif.reliabilityNote: Reminders are delivered while USA Peptide Depot is open or running in the background. If your phone has fully closed the app, a reminder can't arrive until you open it again — anything that came due then shows up on Home with one tap to log it.
notif.testFailed: Couldn't show a notification. Check your device's notification settings for USA Peptide Depot.
notif.reliabilityNotePush: Reminders arrive even when the app is closed. Anything that came due while your phone was off or offline shows up on Home with one tap to log it.
notif.pushNote: To deliver reminders while the app is closed, your device's anonymous push address and the times of your upcoming reminders are sent to our server. Compound names and doses never leave your device.

install.title: Install
install.installed: USA Peptide Depot is installed on this device.
install.available: Install USA Peptide Depot for offline use and reliable notifications.
install.iosInstructions: In Safari, tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This protects your data and is required for notifications on iPhone/iPad.
install.genericInstructions: Open your browser's menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen."

storage.title: Storage
storage.persisted: Your data is protected from automatic cleanup.
storage.notPersisted: Your data isn't protected from automatic cleanup yet — installing the app (see above) helps with this.
storage.backupCaveat: This only protects against automatic cleanup. Uninstalling the app, clearing your browser data, or losing this device still deletes everything — back up regularly (below) so you never lose your history.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.importInvalid: That file doesn't look like a valid USA Peptide Depot backup.
backup.importConfirm: This will replace all data currently on this device with the contents of this backup. This can't be undone.
